name: Moonwell of Cleansing
summary: Tucked away in central Ashenvale along the southwestern bend of the Falfarren River, the Moonwell of Cleansing is a tranquil night elf shrine. Though unmarked on common maps, it sits nestled between Mystral Lake and Silverwing Outpost, offering a place of sacred waters beneath the forest canopy.

sections.title: A Secluded Shrine
sections.body: The Moonwell of Cleansing rests near the southwestern banks of the Falfarren River, just east of Mystral Lake. While it lacks an official marking on regional parchment, a wooden footbridge spans the water to link the site directly to Silverwing Outpost to the east. Night elf travelers and defenders use this sanctuary as a quiet redoubt in a contested woodland, watched over by a solitary faerie dragon—a Blink Dragon—drifting in gentle circles through the silver mist.

sections.title: Waters of the Goddess
sections.body: Like all moonwells constructed by the kaldorei, the basin gathers the luminous blessing of Elune to nurture the surrounding flora and fauna. In a forest increasingly threatened by the Warsong lumber operations and demonic taint stirring near the southern peaks, these pure springs serve as both a spiritual hearth and a bulwark against corruption, preserving the sacred vitality of Ashenvale.

faq.q: Where is the Moonwell of Cleansing located?
aliases: how to find moonwell of cleansing
faq.answer: It is located in Ashenvale along the southwestern stretch of the Falfarren River, situated directly between Mystral Lake to the west and Silverwing Outpost to the east. It is accessible via an unmarked wooden bridge crossing the river.

faq.q: Why isn't this moonwell marked on the map?
faq.answer: Like several smaller shrines and natural crossings throughout Ashenvale, the Moonwell of Cleansing is a minor sanctuary overlooked by standard cartographers, making it a quiet, hidden retreat amidst the thick wilderness.

faq.q: What is the creature circling above the basin?
faq.answer: A Blink Dragon—a type of faerie dragon native to the enchanted woods of the kaldorei—glides endlessly in circles above the shrine, drawn to its magical currents.

faq.q: What purpose do moonwells serve for the night elves?
aliases: why do night elves have moonwells
faq.answer: Moonwells are sacred pools filled with water blessed by Elune and woven with natural magic. Kaldorei druids and priestesses use them to replenish spiritual energy, nourish the wild lands, and counteract regional blights or corruption.

angles.text: Nestled near Silverwing Outpost, this serene pool offers kaldorei defenders a quiet sanctuary to commune with Elune's grace away from the front lines.
The moonwell stands as a pure reservoir of restorative magic, drawing faerie dragons and sustaining the wild growth along the Falfarren River.
